name: DPM++ dual SDE momentumized
plain: Core dpmpp_sde's two-stage midpoint with momentum blended into both stage updates, then a further 3M-style SDE history correction on top. Two model calls per step plus history.
math: s=t+rh, fac=1/(2r). x₂ = (σ(s_)/σ(t))x − v₂((e^{t−s_}−1)·x0₁) + su·n. D=(1−fac)x0₁ + fac·x0₂. x ← (σ(t_next_)/σ(t))x − v₁((e^{t−t_next_}−1)·D). Then history correction with φ terms using h_η, blended by a third velocity. Final noise n·su. v = m·(t + off)·v_prev + (1 − m·(t + off))·diff with t = σᵢ/σ_max, off = −m/2, m = momentum.
